name: incline close grip push up
description: A push-up with hands close together on a raised surface. The easier angle keeps the focus on your triceps.
instructions: Place your hands close together on a bench or sturdy box, just under your chest.
Step back until your body is straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the edge, elbows tucked close to your ribs.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips from sagging throughout.
